messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: route.policy.fallback.loop detected. Health checks flapping between us-east-1 <-> us-west-2 <-> eu-west-1 for service 'text-gen-v2'. Automated fallback is cycling targets. Error spike detected (5xx) from 15:02 UTC. Paging rotation started.
Jin Park: ack — I see the alert. I'm looking at the routing proxy logs.
Riley Chen: on call — paging in. @Jin can you drop the last policy change? I think the new fallback weight config pushed at 14:58 might be causing loops.
Jin Park: pulling the audit log now.
oncall-ops: Paging: Riley Chen (oncall), current rotation: Riley -> Sasha -> Noah.
Jin Park: audit shows rollout: commit 7c9f3a added 'enable_cross_region_fallback: true' and weights=round_robin for fallback. Rollout was 14:58 UTC.
Sasha Patel: I'm joining. TL;DR on customer impact?
Riley Chen: initial metrics: 5xx rate up to 7% for text-gen endpoints for EU customers, latency spikes to 2.3s p95 for some routes. A handful of enterprise customers reported timeouts.
Noah Grant: noted — any traffic loss?
Riley Chen: dropped requests ~12k in last 20m, retries handled by client in many cases but some real errors hitting billing alerts.
Jin Park: I can try to pin routing to nearest-region for the time being. That will stop cross-region fallback.
Sasha Patel: yes please. Also let's temporarily disable the new fallback flag.
Riley Chen: agreed. Steps: 1) set fallback.enabled=false 2) pin routing_policy: prefer_local 3) increase healthcheck grace window to 30s to avoid flapping 4) roll back commit 7c9f3a if needed.
Jin Park: running command to update policy:
```
redwood routing update --service text-gen-v2 --set fallback.enabled=false --set routing_policy=prefer_local
```
Jin Park: applied. Confirming config version 7c9f3a -> 7c9f3a-revert.
IncidentBot: CONFIG_CHANGE: routing policy update applied by Jin Park at 15:08 UTC.
Riley Chen: changing healthcheck window on the pools now (us-east-1/us-west-2/eu-west-1) to 30s grace and 3 failed checks.
Noah Grant: doing drain on us-west-2 for a minute to let KV caches stabilize.
Sasha Patel: monitoring logs. Any sign of the loop stopping?
Jin Park: checking stream: the automated fallback loop count per minute dropped from ~120 to <5 after policy change. 5xx rate trending down.
Riley Chen: latency p95 improving to 930ms for EU. Still some lingering errors from retries but overall better.
Sasha Patel: are any customers still impacted? We should update SRE status page.
Riley Chen: customer-impact assessment: 3 enterprise tenants saw degraded responses for 14:58-15:07 UTC. No data exfiltration. No SLA breach expected given retry behavior, but we will contact impacted customers proactively.
Noah Grant: can we add a guard in the rollout pipeline so future fallback changes require a canary with 0.5% traffic before global?
Jin Park: yes. I'll open a follow-up ticket to require staged rollout + canary for routing changes.
IncidentBot: NOTE: incident declared HIGH for routing.fallback.loop. Incident channel set to #incidents, pagerduty escalation suppressed after ack.
Riley Chen: I'm going to stay on for handoff. Sasha take primary after me in 30m. Noah you'll take postmortem ops tasks.
Sasha Patel: acknowledged. I'll grab the postmortem writeup.
Jin Park: quick triangle check: healthcheck failure reason shows intermittent auth handshake timeout to cache-proxy in us-west-2 causing transient 502s -> triggered fallback -> saturates eu -> back to us-east and so on. Root cause likely an overloaded cache-proxy instance in us-west after a spike. We're adding capacity and updating autoscale thresholds.
Noah Grant: adding a temporary autoscale step for cache-proxy in us-west-2 (+2 instances).
IncidentBot: AUTOACTION: scaled cache-proxy pool us-west-2 to +2 at 15:12 UTC.
Sasha Patel: good. any follow-up mitigation we should take now?
Riley Chen: action list: 
- [ ] Rollback fallback flag permanently until we confirm autoscale fixes
- [ ] Add canary requirement to routing change pipeline
- [ ] Increase healthcheck grace and refine thresholds
- [ ] Postmortem with timeline, root cause, and customer notifications
- [ ] Run chaos test to validate fallback doesn't loop when regional caches flake
Jin Park: I'll own the rollback and pipeline change. Riley you'll own customer comms. Sasha you'll write the postmortem. Noah you'll verify autoscale and capacity.
Noah Grant: will run verification tests and report back in 15m.
Sasha Patel: drafting initial postmortem notes in #incidents-docs.
Riley Chen: sending heads-up to impacted accounts with summary and mitigation steps.
Jin Park: closing loop on immediate incident: fallback loop stopped, 5xx spike reduced to baseline. Keeping incident open for postmortem.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity lowered to MEDIUM at 15:22 UTC.
Sasha Patel: thanks team. I'll take the next oncall handoff notes at 15:40 UTC and start the RCA doc.
Noah Grant: verification looks good, autoscale up kept the cache-proxy healthy.
Riley Chen: leaving handoff: @Sasha you're primary, @Noah secondary.
Sasha Patel: got it.
Jin Park: final note — add integration test in CI that simulates health-check flapping and ensures routing honors prefer_local and doesn't loop.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: provisional resolution applied at 15:45 UTC. Postmortem pending.
